This infrastructure is not a workaround but a base-layer solution that empowers creators to take control of their payment infrastructure, eliminating dependence on third-party services.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The Cloudflare webhook-driven crypto payment fulfillment architecture relies on a combination of Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. Cloudflare Pages serves as the hosting platform for digital products, while Cloudflare Workers handles the backend logic for payment processing. Supabase provides the database for storing orders, and NOWPayments enables automatic on-chain crypto payment verification with 0.5% fees. When a customer makes a payment, the NOWPayments webhook triggers a Cloudflare Worker to verify the payment and update the Supabase database accordingly. This seamless integration enables creators to receive payments instantly and securely, without relying on intermediaries.
